decisions.quote: This is the last reproduction attempt, which concludes that 10 out of 14 claims were successfully reproduced. The remaining four claims could not be reproduced because the respective code was missing. I tried to specify the statistical models myself, but failed because the data files did not include variable labels that allowed to determine the correct model specification.
decisions.reason: Under the codebook, 'technical failure' applies when 'the reproduction could not be attempted or completed at all... No comparable numbers came out,' whereas 'computational issues' applies when 'the analysis ran and produced numbers, but the reported numbers were not obtained: coefficients differed, results could not be recovered, or the paper reports discrepancies it treats as substantive.' Settling the axis across all 14 evaluated claims together, the modified scripts ran and produced comparable numerical output that precisely reproduced 10 out of 14 claims, while results for the remaining 4 claims (Table 1, Models 5-8: pprl8j, q7r685, x6r1p3, j6dqvn) could not be recovered because the model code and variable labels were missing and those claims were marked 'did not reproduce.' Because comparable numerical output was produced for 10 claims but not all reported results could be recovered across the study, the shipped value 'computational issues' is supported.
